name: deepseek-harness-electron
description: A secure cross-platform desktop workbench for DeepSeek Harness.
author: DeepSeek Harness Desktop contributors

scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm harness:dist:validate && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && pnpm harness:dist:validate && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm build && pnpm harness:dist:validate && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:mac:x64: pnpm build && pnpm harness:dist:validate && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && pnpm harness:dist:validate && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:win:arm64: pnpm build && pnpm harness:dist:validate && electron-builder --win nsis --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:win:x64: pnpm build && pnpm harness:dist:validate && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:linux: pnpm build && pnpm harness:dist:validate && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
